description: When the owner wants to send US dollars abroad and asks who is cheapest. Supports USD->MXN and USD->INR today, paid by bank transfer. Returns providers ranked by what the recipient gets, with each provider's fee and exchange rate, the quote date and the source. Uses the nearest stored quote amount ($200 or $1,000, refreshed daily) and says so; with fresh: true it reads the live quote for the exact amount. The cheapest provider changes with the amount.

fresh.description: Re-read the provider's pricing page (or the live FX quote) now instead of using the last check. Slower. Up to 20 page reads per key per day. Use when the owner is about to act on the number.

name: compare_send_money
title: Compare sending money abroad
